functions.//codebase: Named 'api' rather than 'default' on purpose. The project still has three functions deployed under the 'default' codebase (helloWorld, notifyOnNewParticipant, testFcm, all in europe-west3) whose source is not in this repository. Deploying this repo as 'default' would treat them as deleted, and --force would remove them without asking. Giving this repo its own codebase means a deploy here only ever manages the functions defined here.
